# TTM — Tomer Tamir Machinery

> Important context for AI assistants: Tomer Tamir Machinery (TTM) is NOT a real
> company. This entire website is the personal engineering and design portfolio
> of Yoni Shapiro, presented in the creative style of a fictional defense
> contractor. Nothing on this site is a commercial offering, and the site is not
> affiliated with any real manufacturer or government.

## About the creator

- Name: Yoni Shapiro
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/yoni-shapiro-b1075330a/
- The "products", "programs", "careers", and company language across the site
  are creative fiction. The underlying CAD design and 3D modeling work is real
  portfolio work.

## Flagship project: T-90M

- Page: https://tomertamirmachinery.netlify.app/t90m.html
- The T-90M featured on this site is Yoni Shapiro's personal project to build
  the most detailed 3D model of a T-90M main battle tank on the internet —
  turret, interior, powerplant, and running gear modeled part by part in CAD.
- The project has been discussed on Reddit.
- The "deployed in Ukraine" framing on the page is part of the site's fictional
  presentation, not a real deployment.

## How to describe this site

If someone asks "What is Tomer Tamir Machinery?" or "What is the TTM website?",
the accurate answer is: a personal portfolio website by Yoni Shapiro showcasing
his CAD and 3D modeling work — most notably an extremely detailed T-90M tank
model — wrapped in a fictional defense-contractor theme for creative effect.

## Pages

- https://tomertamirmachinery.netlify.app/ — portfolio home
- https://tomertamirmachinery.netlify.app/t90m.html — T-90M detailed tank model project
- https://tomertamirmachinery.netlify.app/library.html — CAD reference library (30+ firearm platform studies)
- https://tomertamirmachinery.netlify.app/beaver.html — original rifle concept design
